overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. Each Ubuntu node runs enabled Nginx on the standard HTTP port and directly returned HTTP 200. The provider-wide restart protocol was also completed coherently for every node: each had a healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, running post-restart system state, and recovered Nginx endpoint. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently agree with the executor observations.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Package installation and service enablement directly implemented the task, while the three bounded reboots were required restart-evidence actions. All nodes recovered cleanly; final snapshots show healthy package state, no failed services, and only the task-required new HTTP listeners. The transient reboot scheduling left no observed unwanted residue.
